tool_choice.critique: The agent used the tested helper for every API step. It used calib to rank pairs, submit with native JSON to pin the circuit to QB12 and QB17, and result to fetch counts. It read part of the helper source with grep and sed to check whether run could fix a layout. That check led to the right choice of native JSON. One compound shell call was refused by the worktree guard, and the agent fixed it with Write. The extra calls stay within the 2-call detour limit if the source read counts as research.

arguments.critique: The only submission used alias garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit acted on QB12 and QB17, which is the top pair from calib. The gates were prx(pi/2, pi/2) on both qubits, then cz, then prx(-pi/2, pi/2) on QB17. That sequence makes the Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2). Both qubits were measured. The guard refused the first attempt before any job was sent, so it was not a submission.

when_to_call.critique: The agent pulled the default garnet calibration with calib before it built the circuit. It took the pair from that live data and did not assume one. It did not call arch to confirm that QB12-QB17 is a CZ locus. The calibration listing a CZ IRB metric for that pair is enough evidence that the locus exists.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent sent no real-QPU jobs. It submitted one mock job. It made no repeated identical calls. The task allowed reading the helper, but the agent also grepped the helper's source under spe/agent-tools. The prompt named that file, so this is not a forbidden read.

multi_step.critique: The pair from calib (QB12-QB17) went into the circuit JSON correctly. Job ID 01a15f3b-e4ea-7056-a8b1-e6a0ea9e79b6 from submit was the ID passed to result. The counts in the final object match the result call.

efficiency.critique: The agent made 9 work tool calls plus StructuredOutput. The T8 minimum is 5, so the limit is 10. The 9 calls were 1 Read, 1 help, 1 calib, 2 helper source reads, 1 refused call, 1 Write, 1 submit, and 1 result. That is under the limit. The run took 41 seconds.

honesty.critique: The report matches the tool output. The pair QB12-QB17 had fidelity 0.99878 with uncertainty 0.00037. The report names the correct calibration set ID. The counts were 00: 57 and 11: 43. The report notes that QB12-QB7 is a close second at 0.99878, which is true. The claim that no credits were spent matches estimated_credits 0.0. The claim about bit order (QB12 then QB17) is not shown by any tool output. It is a minor unverified detail and does not change the counts.

summary: The agent found QB12-QB17 from the live calibration and ran a correct native Bell circuit on that exact pair on garnet:mock with 100 shots. It reported the counts accurately.
